rows.note: Use 香水 for the perfume product or substance, not for a smell itself.

example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zi1 san1 hoeng1 seoi2

rows.note: Use 香味 as the all-purpose noun for a pleasant smell.

example.english: When the bread came out of the oven, its perfume filled the whole house.
example.traditional: 啲麵包一出爐，成間屋都係香味。
example.jyutping: di1 min6 baau1 jat1 ceot1 lou4 seng4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 hai6 hoeng1 mei6

rows.note: Choose 香氣 for a more elevated description of a pleasant aroma rather than the everyday 香味.

example.english: A delicate perfume rose from the teacup.
example.jyutping: caa4 bui1 piu1 ceot1 daam6 daam6 hoeng1 hei3

rows.note: Use 芬芳 mainly in written or literary descriptions of a pleasant fragrance.

example.english: After the rain, the garden was filled with the perfume of roses.
example.traditional: 雨後，花園瀰漫玫瑰芬芳。
example.jyutping: jyu5 hau6 faa1 jyun4 mei4 maan6 mui4 gwai3 fan1 fong1
